ns2:section.sectionText: Description: This course critically examines the ways in which information technologies are both the source and consequence of race and gender relations. Will explore theories of race, gender and technology and apply these to case studies of information and communication technologies (ICTs). Particular attention will be given to globalization, privacy and surveillance, labor, and "digital enclosures". Meets with INFO 390RGI, AAS 390RGI and GWS 395RGI. Location: Room 242 LIS Building, 501 E. Daniel St., Champaign.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
